rows.hypothesis: Plain reference encoding is accepted on a healthy path
A maximum TTL is forwarded unchanged in effect
A minimum TTL only reaches a directly attached Responder
DSCP EF with ECN ECT(0) marking is not dropped
An ECN CE marking is not dropped
A maximum IPv4 identification is not dropped
Setting DF on a datagram that fits the path is accepted
An IPv4 Router Alert option is not dropped
A zero UDP checksum, legal over IPv4, is accepted
An ECN ECT(1) marking, distinct from ECT(0) and CE, is not dropped
A zero IPv4 identification on an unfragmented datagram is not dropped
An IPv4 datagram split into two in-order fragments with a zero UDP checksum is reassembled and accepted
An IPv4 datagram whose second fragment arrives first, with a zero UDP checksum, is reassembled and accepted
IPv4 options holding NOPs and end-of-options padding are not dropped
